MomentCounterexample.objectivePolynomial: ∀ a b c x : ℝ, (MomentCounterexample.objectivePolynomial a b c).eval x = MomentCounterexample.objective a b c x
MomentCounterexample.originalFeasible_if: ∀ x : ℝ, MomentCounterexample.originalFeasible x ↔ -1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1
MomentCounterexample.moment_bounds: ∀ {y : ℕ → ℝ}, MomentCounterexample.hierarchyFeasible 1 y → y 1 ^ 2 ≤ y 2 ∧ y 2 ≤ 1 ∧ -1 ≤ y 1 ∧ y 1 ≤ 1
MomentCounterexample.dirac_feasible: ∀ x : ℝ, MomentCounterexample.originalFeasible x → MomentCounterexample.hierarchyFeasible 1 (MomentCounterexample.diracMoments x)
MomentCounterexample.feasible_has_atomic: ∀ {y : ℕ → ℝ}, MomentCounterexample.hierarchyFeasible 1 y → MomentCounterexample.atomicRepresentation y
MomentCounterexample.round_feasible: ∀ {y : ℕ → ℝ}, MomentCounterexample.hierarchyFeasible 1 y → ∀ a b c : ℝ, ∃ x : ℝ, MomentCounterexample.originalFeasible x ∧ MomentCounterexample.objective a b c x ≤ MomentCounterexample.relaxedObjective a b c y
MomentCounterexample.exists_original_min: ∀ a b c : ℝ, ∃ x₀ : ℝ, MomentCounterexample.originalFeasible x₀ ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, MomentCounterexample.originalFeasible x → MomentCounterexample.objective a b c x₀ ≤ MomentCounterexample.objective a b c x
MomentCounterexample.attained_exactness: ∀ a b c : ℝ, ∃ x₀ : ℝ, ∃ y₀ : ℕ → ℝ, MomentCounterexample.originalFeasible x₀ ∧ MomentCounterexample.hierarchyFeasible 1 y₀ ∧ MomentCounterexample.objective a b c x₀ = MomentCounterexample.relaxedObjective a b c y₀ ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, MomentCounterexample.originalFeasible x → MomentCounterexample.objective a b c x₀ ≤ MomentCounterexample.objective a b c x) ∧ (∀ y : ℕ → ℝ, MomentCounterexample.hierarchyFeasible 1 y → MomentCounterexample.relaxedObjective a b c y₀ ≤ MomentCounterexample.relaxedObjective a b c y)
MomentCounterexample.complete_counterexa: MomentCounterexample.constraint.natDegree = 2 ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, MomentCounterexample.originalFeasible x ↔ -1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1) ∧ IsLeast {r : ℕ | MomentCounterexample.exactAt r} 1 ∧ ¬MomentCounterexample.minimalOrderFormula
